query.formula: A[] forall(i : id_t) (EV(i).TicketCheck imply serv == local_ticket[i])
A<> forall(i : int[0, N-1]) (EV(i).SendReq imply EV(i).Charging)
A[] forall(i : int[0, N-1]) forall(j : int[0, N-1]) (i != j imply not (EV(i).Charging and EV(j).Charging))
A[] forall(i : int[0, N-1]) (EV(i).Charging imply EVclock[i] <= 600)
A[] forall(i : int[0, N-1]) (EV(i).SendReq imply EVclock[i] <= 20)
